sam: Heads-up: change window tomorrow 02:00 UTC. We need a final preflight checklist and a confirmed rollback target for the model pin.
leo: Confirmed pin: inference-api@v2026-04-01-pin-2. I uploaded the release notes to /docs/releases/2026-04-01.md.
tara: I'll run the preflight smoke and the canary leak test at T-2h.
sam: Key acceptance criteria: no 5xx >0.3%, p95 < 220ms, and A/B quality parity pass.
leo: Deploy bot dry-run queued. deploy-bot: dry-run started by @leo  id db-2765432199-dry.
ops_oncall: Rollback target agreed: v2026-03-28-pin-9. I've validated the rollback healthcheck script in staging.
sam: Add note: DB migrations are no-op for this release. No schema changes.
tara: Acked. Runbook open and pinned.
leo: I'll start traffic-shift plan doc and a staged ramp (10%, 30%, 60%, 100%) with 10m waits.
ops_oncall: I'll shadow and hold escalation channel. If error rate >0.5% or p95 jumps by +80ms we immediate rollback.
sam: Looks good. Final go at T-30m. Everyone ack here. :white_check_mark:
leo: Ack.
tara: Ack.
ops_oncall: Ack, standing by.
